title: Windrow House Rising Revisited
author: M. M. Quintana
blurb: Quentin Vasquez, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
